name: RoadTextVQA goal-conditioned background-IDF verifier third fresh OCR replay
question: When the user's destination is already known, can background-calibrated evidence verify only that goal instead of misclassifying a multi-business scene as one globally exclusive roster entry?
observed_before_freeze: Two fresh thirty-video panels independently showed five to six additional correct rows from information-weighted text evidence.
The remaining wrong or ambiguous rows were dominated by genuinely co-visible names belonging to other roster businesses, not by common-word contamination alone.
Ten-meter assistance is conditioned on a user-selected destination; it does not need to identify every visible business as a mutually exclusive class.

selection_state_at_freeze.selection_rule: Thirty fixed, one-video-per-row name questions, disjoint from the development video and both prior fresh panels.

idf_contract.normalization: Unicode NFKD ASCII fold, lowercase alphanumeric individual OCR tokens; source full-text summary excluded.
idf_contract.information_formula: For each matched target token, log2((2635+1)/(training_video_document_frequency+1)); sum distinct token bits across ten frames.
idf_contract.goal_conditioning: Evaluate only the user-selected target aliases. A positive match can emit only that target; co-visible names are neither candidates nor negative evidence.
idf_contract.association: Four- and five-character tokens require exact OCR; length six or longer permits edit distance one. At least eight background-information bits are required.
idf_contract.authority: Search-priority visibility candidate for the conditioned goal only; no pixel text localization, sign-to-entity association, exact physical identity, facade, portal, entrance, access, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, or safety authority.

synthetic_negative_contract.formula: For each fixed row, SHA256(question_id|video|salt), map the first ten hex nibbles to letters a-p, then prefix zz.
synthetic_negative_contract.authority: Generated absent-query canaries only; not human-verified scene target-absence truth.

cyclic_cross_video_challenge.formula: Apply the next selected row's target aliases to the current row's video, wrapping at the end.
cyclic_cross_video_challenge.authority: Collision diagnostic only. Because target absence is not independently annotated, accepts are not false-positive counts and do not gate the result.

execution_rule: Run exactly once. Do not change selected rows, excluded videos, IDF corpus, eight-bit threshold, token lengths, edit distance, conditioning, or gate after observing selected OCR.

claim_boundary.allowed: Development evidence for goal-conditioned, background-calibrated lexical search-priority verification on a third fresh OCR-unseen RoadTextVQA validation panel.
not_allowed: human-verified target-absent specificity, benchmark-test, blind, independent, provider-controlled, city-disjoint, open-world, conformal, FDR-controlled, deployment, product, benefit, reliability, or safety confirmation
pixel text localization or a token proving exact physical entity identity, sign ownership, facade ownership, portal ownership, or entrance ownership
public access, traversability, waypoint correctness, arrival, or handoff
